what: controls for the cotangent scan, measured in this row own process

A16_zero_cotangent_baseline.what: a cotangent of exact zeros scored against the float64 reference must read 1.0 at every rung

BREAK_rung_shift_3.what: our cotangent at rung k scored against the reference at rung k+3. Same tensors, same masking, wrong pairing: a scan that could not tell them apart would be measuring nothing

BREAK_token_permutation.what: our per-block injection cotangent with its 56 real token positions permuted, scored against the same reference. Everything else identical.
